_note: Transform authoring contracts. VERIFIED INVARIANT across every metric observed: for a given transformId, the `authoring` block (parameters, calculationSummary, formula, operandOrder, nullBehavior) is byte-identical regardless of which metric it is attached to. Per-metric variation lives only in: which transformIds are offered, spreadOperands, rankOrderings, and the presence of operandRequired/sideRequired/chainSuccessors flags.

value.label: Value

offset.description: Bars before the latest value; 0 selects the current resolved value.

value.calculationSummary: Select one value at the requested offset.
value.nullBehavior: Returns null when the requested slot is absent or the source value is null.

trajectory.label: Trajectory

window.description: Number of non-null observations represented by the trajectory.

bars.description: Which bars feed the series: 'all' includes the live forming bar as now; 'closed' uses closed bars only.

trajectory.calculationSummary: Render the recent build-up plus its rising, falling, or flat direction.
trajectory.formula: slots = last window non-null base values; trend = compare(first, last)
trajectory.nullBehavior: Missing observations produce null slots; an empty series has null now and trend.
trajectory.emitsNote: window value slots (_t{n-1}..._t1, _now) plus one _trend direction output.

distance.label: Distance from price
distance.calculationSummary: Measure signed percentage distance from current price to a price-level metric.
distance.nullBehavior: Returns null when price or the base level is null, or when the base level is zero.

spread.label: Spread vs metric

inputs.description: Exactly one candle-backed operand metric, resolved at the base column timeframe.

spread.calculationSummary: Measure the signed percentage gap between the base and one operand metric.
spread.nullBehavior: Returns null when either operand is null or the second operand is zero.

efficiency.label: Efficiency (ER)

window.description: Number of non-null POINTS in the window — N moves needs window N+1.

bars.description: Which bars feed the series: 'all' includes the live forming bar; 'closed' uses closed bars only.

efficiency.calculationSummary: Measure how directly the series travelled: net movement divided by the total distance covered.
efficiency.formula: output = |base[last] - base[first]| / sum(|base[i] - base[i-1]|) over the window
efficiency.nullBehavior: Returns null when the window holds fewer than two non-null points, or when every consecutive delta is zero (a flat series has no efficiency).

bandTouch.label: Band touch
bandTouch.calculationSummary: Classify current price proximity to the canonical upper and lower bands.
bandTouch.nullBehavior: Returns null when the price or band values required by the classifier are unavailable.
bandTouch.note: Authorable but used by ZERO platform templates.

classifyZone.label: Zone label
classifyZone.calculationSummary: Classify a bounded oscillator with its canonical overbought and oversold policy.
classifyZone.nullBehavior: Returns null when the source oscillator is null.

maxShare.label: Largest share

window.description: Number of non-null observations included in the window total.

bars.description: Which bars feed the series: 'all' includes the live forming bar; 'closed' uses closed bars only.

maxShare.calculationSummary: Report how much of the window total sits in its single largest observation.
maxShare.nullBehavior: Returns null when the window holds no non-null values, or when they total zero (a share of nothing is not a number).

rank.label: Peer rank

ordering.description: Which end of the universe rank 1 names: Highest, Lowest, Furthest from zero, or Closest to zero. The magnitude pair is offered only where the metric can be negative.

rank.calculationSummary: Read the platform-computed ordinal for the base metric across the tracked universe. The ranked set holds current values only, so there is no historical ordinal to offset into.
rank.formula: output = ordinal(base among the ranked universe, by the chosen ordering)
rank.nullBehavior: Returns null when the ranked universe carries no entry for the asset.
rank.note: Current values only — no historical offset. Allowed orderings are per-metric policy (see rankOrderings), NOT derivable from whether the metric can be negative.

crossDetect.label: Cross detect
crossDetect.calculationSummary: Detect a bullish or bearish crossing in the canonical source series.
crossDetect.nullBehavior: Returns null when the two observations required for crossing are unavailable.

aggregate.label: Windowed aggregate

window.description: Number of history observations included in the canonical mean.

aggregate.calculationSummary: Compute the mean of non-null history values in the selected window.
aggregate.nullBehavior: Returns null when the selected history window has no non-null values.
aggregate.note: Mean only — there is no sum/min/max variant.

count.label: Zone count
count.calculationSummary: Count active entities in the resolved set.
count.nullBehavior: An empty resolved set returns zero; an unavailable entity set returns null.

nearestZoneType.label: Nearest zone type

side.description: Select whether the nearest support or resistance zone is resolved.

nearestZoneType.calculationSummary: Return the canonical type of the nearest zone on the selected side.
nearestZoneType.nullBehavior: Returns null when no active zone exists on the selected side.

nearestZoneRange.label: Nearest zone range

side.description: Select whether the nearest support or resistance zone is resolved.

nearestZoneRange.calculationSummary: Return the low-to-high price range of the nearest zone on the selected side.
nearestZoneRange.formula: output = [low, high] of nearest(base filtered by side)
nearestZoneRange.nullBehavior: Returns null when no active zone exists on the selected side.

nearestZoneDist.label: Nearest zone distance

side.description: Select whether the nearest support or resistance zone is resolved.

nearestZoneDist.calculationSummary: Measure signed percentage distance from price to the nearest zone midpoint.
nearestZoneDist.nullBehavior: Returns null when no active zone exists on the selected side or its midpoint is zero.

nearestZoneAge.label: Nearest zone age

side.description: Select whether the nearest support or resistance zone is resolved.

nearestZoneAge.calculationSummary: Return whole hours since the nearest zone was detected.
nearestZoneAge.nullBehavior: Returns null when no active zone exists on the selected side.
